y-m-34-05.title: Uma isibalo silungile, siyamukelwa yini njengesiphumo nokusele?
y-m-34-05.topic: Ukuhlukanisa i-polynomial: umbandela wokuba yisiphumo nokusele noma A=BQ+R ibambile
y-m-34-05.goal: Qinisekisa wena ukuthi kunama-(Q,R) amaningana lapho A=B·Q+R ibamba khona, uqonde ukuthi kudingeka umbandela wezinga lokusele ukuze zamukelwe njengesiphumo nokusele, bese uqhubeka nokuhlukanisa ngokulungisa impendulo engafaneli umbandela.
y-m-34-05.material:
Hlukanisa u-A(x)=x³+2x²+3x+4 ngo-B(x)=x²+1. Abafundi abathathu bathi lokhu okulandelayo, futhi bonke abathathu baqinisekisa ukuthi 'A=B·Q+R iyabamba'.
  UJimin: isiphumo Q=x+2, okusele R=2x+2
  UHarin: isiphumo Q=x+1, okusele R=x²+2x+3
  UDoyun: isiphumo Q=x, okusele R=2x²+2x+4
